notes: Select a component on the video to see it outlined: drag it to move it, drag a corner to resize it, and its settings open in the sidebar.
Click a component on the video or its block on the timeline to edit it in the sidebar: text, timing and style, with changes playing straight away.
New components are centred on the frame, and their dark backing no longer gets clipped.
Simpler settings panel; the tab underline slides between Notes, Library and Captions.
Components you add now just play on the video: no outlines or bands, and slim blocks on the timeline.
